feeds.title: Institute of Pranic Healing UK & Ireland Blog
feeds.description: The Institute of Pranic Healing UK & Ireland provides a comprehensive 3 stage personal development system that enables you to realise and maximise your full potential in all areas of your life including relationships, business, finances and your physical, emotional and mental health and well being. Since 1987 these courses have been transforming the lives of millions of students.

feeds.title: Pranic Healing Ontario Blog
feeds.description: Founded by Antjie Halim in Elora, Ontario, it provided yoga classes and self-growth/development workshops. In 1995, besides teaching yoga, Antjie became a full-time Pranic Healer. Now the centre is here to educate the public on the art and science of Pranic Healing.

feeds.title: Daily Miracles through Pranic Healing
feeds.description: Daily Miracles through Pranic Healing Blog shares experiences and ideas of applying Pranic Healing and Master Choa Kok Sui's teachings to various aspects of life.

feeds.title: Prana World Blog
feeds.description: The Prana World blog is the source from which you can find all the articles related to pranic healing & arhatic yoga about healing, spirituality, success & love. Through Prana World Projects, we have tried to bring the knowledge of Prana, Spirituality and Pranic Healing, introduced and developed by Master Choa Kok Sui, into every single part of our life, to enrich, empower and make it a brilliant success.

feeds.title: Pranic Healing Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Pranic Healing Foundation (PHF) is a Non-profit Charitable institution. It has been established to promote and spread GMCKS Pranic Healing and Arhatic Yoga in Mauritius, and also to support & empower people towards greater peace, greater love, holistic health and spirituality.

feeds.title: AZ Pranic Healing Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Allison Kennelly. I specialize in working with all ages, where all sessions are done remotely so you can relax in the comfort of your own home during your healing session. I use Pranic Healing and CranioSacral therapy to work with adults who are tired of not feeling well, who are in physical or emotional pain and are looking to treat the cause rather than the symptoms.

feeds.title: Pranic Healing East Africa Blog
feeds.description: The East Africa Pranic Healing Foundation was established in 2004. The objective was to promote Pranic Healing. Developed by Master Choa Kok Sui, Pranic Healing addresses all aspects of life including health, relationships, finances and spirituality, leading you to live a happy, healthy and stress-free life.

feeds.title: Nileema Jhunjhunwala Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Nileema Jhunjhunwala, a life coach, pranic healer and meditation trainer. I share my experiences and do everything that gives me joy. While doing what I do, I aspire to inspire you to do what brings you joy. If you are looking for someone to listen to you, understand your perspective, help you find your answers and guide you in transforming your thought patterns and belief system you are in the right place.

feeds.title: Pranalaya Blog
feeds.description: The pranalaya blog gives more insights on pranic Healing which provides a Bridge for the Soul to grow. Pranic Healing is a gateway to the Higher Teachings. Helps in accelerating our Soul development.
